opening.argument: The promotion ties its earning opportunity directly to recruitment and a people-based structure. It states that income comes from "Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people," while presenting a bonus plan under which 400 people supposedly earned 35,000 euros a week in only 12 months. It then urges viewers to "Enter our program now and join more than 650 000 partners" and directs them to click "I WANT TO EARN MONEY." These are not merely general claims about a currency: they connect substantial earnings to recruiting participants and provide a direct path to register as a partner.
